Badenoch insists she’s an ‘old-school Conservative’ as Tory conference gets under way
Conservative Party leader Kemi Badenoch has published her own personal manifesto, saying she’s a ‘classic old-school Conservative’ on the opening day of the party’s conference in Birmingham.
She told delegates that the best time to have arguments over policy and how to spend limited resources is before being elected to govern.
